checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-CALLER-TO-BLAKE2-PRECOMPILE: Gas Metering Validation at BLAKE2 F Precompile Entry
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Identify the gas cost computation for the BLAKE2 F precompile (address 0x09): gas_cost = rounds * GFROUND where GFROUND=1. 2. Verify that the gas availability check occurs BEFORE any compression function execution. 3. Craft test inputs with rounds values near the uint32 boundary (0, 1, 2^31-1, 2^32-1) and confirm gas_cost = rounds * 1 is correctly computed without integer overflow. 4. Submit a call with exactly (rounds * 1) - 1 gas available and verify the call reverts with out-of-gas. 5. Submit a call with exactly (rounds * 1) gas and verify the call succeeds. 6. Confirm that when gas is insufficient, no state changes occur and no partial output is returned.
executable_checks: Test: call BLAKE2 F precompile with rounds=1000, gas=999 → expect out-of-gas failure
Test: call BLAKE2 F precompile with rounds=1000, gas=1000 → expect success
Test: call BLAKE2 F precompile with rounds=2^32-1, gas=2^32-2 → expect out-of-gas failure
Test: call BLAKE2 F precompile with rounds=0, gas=0 → expect success (zero-cost call)
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP152-PRECOND-003. Boundary edge EDGE-CALLER-TO-BLAKE2-PRECOMPILE from EXT-PRECOMPILE-CALLER. Primary element: ACTION-CHECK-GAS-AVAILABLE. Related assumption: ASSUM-EIP152-03.

checklist.title: Verify Gas Cost Computation Integrity for BLAKE2 F Rounds Parameter
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate the code path where rounds is extracted from the first 4 bytes of input and multiplied by GFROUND (=1). 2. Verify that the rounds extraction uses big-endian uint32 decoding and cannot produce values outside [0, 2^32-1]. 3. Verify the multiplication rounds * GFROUND cannot overflow the gas type (typically uint64). 4. Confirm STATE-INSUFFICIENT-GAS is reached when computed cost exceeds available gas, and that the EDGE-GAS-FAIL transition is atomic.
executable_checks: Test: verify rounds extraction from malformed input (< 4 bytes) is handled by prior length check
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP152-PRECOND-003. Covers nodes STATE-ROUNDS-EXTRACTED, ACTION-COMPUTE-GAS-COST, ACTION-CHECK-GAS-AVAILABLE, STATE-INSUFFICIENT-GAS.

checklist.title: Falsify Post-Fork Blob Gas Reset: Verify excess_blob_gas Initializes to 0 and Blob Base Fee Equals MIN_BASE_FEE_PER_BLOB_GAS
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Identify the fork boundary detection logic (timestamp-based) and the calc_excess_blob_gas function. 2. Construct a scenario where the parent block is pre-fork (no excess_blob_gas or legacy value) and the current block is the first post-fork block. 3. Verify that excess_blob_gas is set to exactly 0 at the fork boundary, regardless of parent header contents. 4. Compute the blob base fee using the post-fork formula with excess_blob_gas=0 and verify it equals MIN_BASE_FEE_PER_BLOB_GAS. 5. Attempt to falsify: set parent excess_blob_gas to a large non-zero value and verify that at the fork boundary, excess_blob_gas still resets to 0 (not carried over). 6. Verify the second post-fork block correctly reads the first post-fork block's excess_blob_gas=0 and computes the next value normally.
executable_checks: Test: first post-fork block with parent excess_blob_gas=999999 → excess_blob_gas still == 0
Test: second post-fork block reads parent excess_blob_gas=0 and applies normal calc
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP7762-POSTCOND-001. Primary element: STATE-POST-FORK. Related assumption: ASSUM-EIP7762-01. Covers nodes ACTION-CALC-EXCESS-BLOB-GAS, ACTION-CALC-BLOB-BASE-FEE and edges EDGE-ENTER-POST-FORK, EDGE-READ-PARENT-EXCESS.

checklist.title: Falsify Checkpoint Sync Trust Invariant: Attempt to Proceed with Unverified or Invalid Checkpoint State Root
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate the checkpoint sync initialization path and the state root verification logic (ACTION-VERIFY-CHECKPOINT). 2. Identify where the checkpoint state root is compared against a known trusted source. 3. Attempt to falsify the invariant by providing a checkpoint with a valid format but an incorrect state root that does not match any trusted source. 4. Verify the client rejects the checkpoint and does NOT proceed to sync from the invalid state. 5. Test edge case: provide a checkpoint with a state root that was once valid but has since been superseded — verify the client handles stale checkpoints correctly. 6. Verify that skipping verification entirely (e.g., null or missing trusted source) results in a hard failure, not a permissive fallback.
executable_checks: Test: checkpoint with wrong state root → client rejects and halts sync
Test: checkpoint with correct state root → client proceeds
Test: checkpoint verification with no trusted source configured → hard failure
Test: stale but once-valid checkpoint → verify behavior (reject or warn)
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP6916-INV-004. Primary element: STATE-CHECKPOINT-SYNC. Related assumption: ASSUM-EIP6916-01. Covers edge EDGE-CHECKPOINT-VERIFY.

checklist.title: Falsify SHA256 Precompile Output Correctness: Verify Output Is Exactly 32 Bytes of Correct SHA-256 Hash
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate the SHA256 precompile implementation at address 0x02. 2. For a set of known test vectors (empty input, 1-byte input, large input), call the precompile and verify the output matches the expected SHA-256 digest. 3. Verify the output length is exactly 32 bytes for all inputs, including empty input and maximum-size input. 4. Attempt to falsify: check if any input length produces output != 32 bytes. 5. Verify no side effects: calling SHA256 precompile does not modify any state (storage, balance, etc.). 6. Verify determinism: same input always produces same output across multiple calls.
executable_checks: Test: SHA256('') == expected_empty_hash and output length == 32
Test: SHA256(0xff) == expected_hash and output length == 32
Test: SHA256(large_input_10KB) == expected_hash and output length == 32
Test: two calls with same input produce identical output
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-PRECOMP-POSTCOND-003. Primary element: ACTION-SHA256. Covers node STATE-SHA256-RESULT and edge EDGE-SHA256-RESULT.
